physical_state_in: Political framework (Danube Commission; Belgrade Convention) and TEN-T designation
physical_state_out: Harmonised navigation rules; published fairway notices; vessel registration standards across 13 states
primary_transformation: Danube Commission multilateral coordination; national transposition; fairway certification and documentation
typical_time_scale: Annual regulatory cycle; multi-year treaty revision
measurable_output: Harmonisation index (common standards across member states); fairway notice currency (%); vessel compliance rate
D_parameters: Belgrade Convention (1948) requirements; UNECE inland navigation conventions; EU Directive 2005/44/EC RIS; TEN-T Regulation 1315/2013
C_parameters: Harmonised rules set; fairway notices published; RIS coverage; vessel certificates issued
notes: 13 member states; 85% harmonised vessel registration; 78% RIS coverage; 92% fairway notice currency. Strong institutional framework.

physical_state_in: Vessels arriving at Danube ports with cargo
physical_state_out: Cargo loaded or unloaded; transshipment to rail road pipeline completed; customs cleared
primary_transformation: Quay-side cargo handling; storage and warehousing; intermodal transfer; customs clearance
typical_time_scale: Hours to days per vessel call
measurable_output: Port throughput by commodity (Mt/yr); vessel turnaround time (hr); intermodal connection rate (%)
D_parameters: EU port state control standards; national customs regulations; Danube Commission port equipment guidelines
C_parameters: Cargo throughput achieved; vessel turnaround; intermodal connections; port utilisation rate
notes: 68 active ports; 34 Mt/yr throughput; 75 Mt/yr capacity (45% utilisation); 18 hr turnaround; 52% intermodal connection. Non-EU port score 0.48.

physical_state_in: Natural river channel with variable water levels and mobile sediment
physical_state_out: Maintained fairway meeting minimum depth (2.5 m design; 1.5-2.0 m actual) and width standards
primary_transformation: Maintenance dredging; gravel removal; bank revetment; groyne maintenance; channel marking
measurable_output: Fairway depth compliance (days/yr at 2.5 m); dredging volume (m3/yr); low-water restriction days/yr
output_unit: days at depth; m3/yr; restriction days
D_parameters: TEN-T fairway standard 2.5 m depth; EIA requirements for dredging; WFD no-deterioration obligation for channel substrate
C_parameters: Days meeting 2.5 m standard; dredging volume; low-water restriction days; fairway compliance %
notes: 4.5 Mm3/yr dredged at EUR 28M/yr; 42 low-water restriction days avg (68 in 2022); 74% fairway depth compliance; 7 critical shallows. PRIMARY BOTTLENECK (72%).

physical_state_in: Vessels entering navigable reaches and lock systems
physical_state_out: Vessels transiting the river with cargo; passage through lock systems at Iron Gate and Gabcikovo-Nagymaros
primary_transformation: River transit; lock passage; convoy assembly; customs transit; AIS reporting
typical_time_scale: Days for full Danube transit; hours per lock
measurable_output: Annual vessel passages (count); average transit time (days); lock waiting time (hr)
D_parameters: Iron Gate operating protocol between Romania and Serbia; Gabcikovo-Nagymaros treaty (Hungary/Slovakia); UNECE ADN regulations for hazardous cargo
C_parameters: Vessel passages completed; transit time; lock waiting time; AIS coverage; cargo moved
notes: 6800 passages Iron Gate; 7200 Gabcikovo; 3.2 hr avg lock wait; 13 days full transit; 95% AIS coverage. STRONGEST PHASE (85%).

physical_state_in: Cargo delivered to destination ports; trade facilitation service provided
physical_state_out: Economic value to shippers (freight savings); port employment; regional trade facilitation
primary_transformation: Revenue realisation; freight cost savings vs road; employment generation at ports; value added in processing
measurable_output: Trade value facilitated (EUR bn/yr); freight cost savings vs road (EUR mn/yr); port employment (FTE)
output_unit: EUR bn/yr; EUR mn/yr savings; FTE
D_parameters: EU State Aid rules; national port concession agreements; Danube Commission revenue sharing protocols
C_parameters: Trade value facilitated; freight savings; employment generated; investment return on TEN-T
notes: EUR 6.5 bn/yr trade value; EUR 420M/yr freight savings vs road; 93000 port FTE; EUR 85M/yr revenue lost to low-water restrictions; EUR 4.2 bn TEN-T backlog.
